notes:
Node text shows headings, lists, code, quotes, highlights and nicer tables, like FoxText
- Can now be updated by FoxUpdater
Smarter editing: Enter continues lists and tables, Alt+Up/Down moves lines, Ctrl+Up/Down folds list items, and more
Enter in a table cell moves the rest into an empty cell below; map back/forward is now Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab
Column (box) selection with Alt+drag, drag picked gutter rows to move them, Backspace removes a whole picture link
Alt+drag starts a column selection even on a bracket; Alt+click swaps the ends of a selection or column box; deleting the first character of a picture link removes it whole
Tap Shift+Alt to swap the ends of a selection or column selection; Shift+Alt+click extends the selection
Shift+click extends a selection by letters, Ctrl+Shift+click by words; Alt during a drag-selection makes it a column selection
